joints.name: Shoulder
joints.note: Flexion about the mediolateral axis, then abduction about the anteroposterior axis, then rotation about the humeral axis (intrinsic order); angles relative to the trunk. Clavicle and scapula follow with a fixed scapulohumeral rhythm (scapula rotates by 1/3 of the humeral elevation)

joints.name: Sternoclavicular (coupled)
joints.note: coupled: clavicle elevation = 1/12 of the humeral elevation

joints.name: Acromioclavicular (coupled)
joints.note: coupled: scapular upward rotation = 1/4 of the humeral elevation

joints.name: Elbow
joints.note: hinge about the transepicondylar axis

joints.name: Forearm rotation
joints.note: radius rotates about the line radial head - ulnar head; 0 = neutral (thumb up, AAOS)

joints.name: Wrist
joints.note: flexion about the radio-ulnar axis of the wrist, then radial/ulnar deviation about the axis normal to the palm; carpal bones move with the hand (no intercarpal motion)

joints.name: Thumb CMC
joints.note: saddle joint approximated by two axes: flexion across the palm, palmar abduction out of it

joints.name: Hip
joints.note: flexion, then abduction, then rotation about the femoral axis (intrinsic order); angles relative to the pelvis frame (hip centres, sacrum, hip bones)

joints.name: Knee
joints.note: hinge about the transepicondylar axis (no tibial rotation / screw-home in this preview)

joints.name: Patella (coupled)
joints.note: patella follows 60% of the knee flexion angle about the same axis (ASSUMPTION, Hehne 1990-type ratio)

joints.name: Ankle
joints.note: talocrural hinge through the malleolar tips

joints.name: Ankle (subtalar)
joints.note: subtalar axis after Inman (1976): 42 deg above the horizontal, 23 deg medial to the foot axis, through the inferior talus (literature axis, not fitted)

regions.name: Lumbar spine
regions.note: Zero = the spine as built; the displayed range is the regional average range of motion, shared between the levels (equal shares; the C1/C2 joint carries 50% of cervical rotation, the occiput/C1 joint 20% of flexion) - ASSUMPTION

regions.name: Thoracic spine
regions.note: Zero = the spine as built; the displayed range is the regional average range of motion, shared between the levels (equal shares; the C1/C2 joint carries 50% of cervical rotation, the occiput/C1 joint 20% of flexion) - ASSUMPTION

regions.name: Head / neck (cervical spine + atlanto-occipital)

ankle_dp: Q245: dorsiflexion non-weight-bearing, knee flexed, Baumbach 2014: 20 +- 9 (+ 1 SD 29; weight-bearing 39 +- 7); with the KNEE EXTENDED only 4 +- 7 (AAOS 20); plantarflexion AAOS 50, abstract only
ankle_inv: AAOS inversion 0-35, eversion 0-15 = foot (subtalar + transverse tarsal), all given to the subtalar joint here = ASSUMPTION (abstract only, not verified)
cerv_flex: Q245: Apti 2023 goniometer n 300 (18-29 y): flexion 57.7 +- 8.2, extension 59.1 +- 10.2 (+ 1 SD 66 / 69); head + neck (occiput included); AAOS 45 / 45, AMA 50 / 60
cerv_rot: Q245: Apti 2023 (n 300, 18-29 y): right 71.1 +- 10.5, left 70.2 +- 9.7 (+ 1 SD 81); AAOS 60, AMA 80; C1/C2 carries 36.2 per side (Ishii 2004)
elbow_flex: Q245: Zwerus 2019 active flexion 146, passive 3-5 larger = about 150 (AAOS 150, AMA 140); extension 0 (Zwerus: active -2)
finger_dip: AAOS DIP flexion 0-70/90, 80 used = ASSUMPTION (Hume 1990 functional 39; Mallon 1991: tenodesis effect at the DIP)
finger_mcp: AAOS MCP flexion 0-90, hyperextension 0-45 (abstract only, not verified; Mallon 1991 no values in the abstract; Hume 1990 functional 61)
finger_pip: AAOS PIP flexion 0-100 (abstract only, not verified; Hume 1990 functional 60)
forearm_sup: Q245: Zwerus 2019 active pronation 80 / supination 87 + passive 3-5 = pronation 84 / supination 91 (AAOS 80 / 80)
hip_abd: Q245: Roaas 1982 (men 30-40, passive): abduction 38.5, adduction 30.5 (AAOS 45 / 30); one source, via a snippet
hip_flex: Q245: Soucie 2011 passive, ages 20-44 (CDC table, snippet): flexion F 133.8 / M 130.4 -> 132; extension F 18.1 / M 17.4 -> 18 (Roaas 1982: 120 / 9.5; AAOS 120 / 30)
hip_rot: Q245: Kouyoumdjian 2012 (n 120, 20-60 y): ER 38.5-41.8, IR 29.6-37.9 depending on position (mean ER 40, IR 34); AAOS 45 / 45
knee_flex: Q245: Soucie 2011 passive, ages 20-44 (CDC table, snippet): F 141.9 / M 137.7 -> 140 (AAOS 135 active, AMA 140)
lumb_flex: AAOS lumbar flexion 0-60, extension 0-25 (abstract only, not verified); Pearcy 1984 about 14 per level (= 70 over 5 levels, vs 85 here)
lumb_lat: AAOS lumbar lateral flexion 0-25 each side (abstract only, not verified); Pearcy 1984 10 / 10 / 10 / 6 / 3 per level (one-sided vs total not stated)
lumb_rot: White & Panjabi lumbar axial rotation ~5 each side (book, not re-read); Pearcy 1984 about 2 per level (if one-sided: 10 over 5 levels)
shoulder_abd: AAOS abduction 0-180 (abstract only, not verified); adduction in the frontal plane -30 = ASSUMPTION (AAOS/AMA cross-body adduction 30-50 is horizontal adduction)
shoulder_flex: Q245: flexion = passive mean + 1 SD, Vairo 2012 (170.2 +- 8.6, n 622, 18 y; AAOS 180); extension AAOS 60, abstract only (not verified) - shoulder complex, scapula included
shoulder_rot: Q245: Vairo 2012 passive mean + 1 SD: ER 81.4 +- 12.0 (arm at side, elbow 90), IR 60.7 +- 13.4 (arm at 90 abduction); ER reaches 103-105 at 90 abduction (AAOS 90 / 70)
thor_flex: White & Panjabi thoracic flexion ~20-40, extension ~15-25 (not re-read); extension 20 consistent with Edmondston 2012 (12.8 +- 7.6 with arm elevation); flexion 30 = ASSUMPTION
thor_lat: White & Panjabi ~25 each side (book, not re-read) - ASSUMPTION
thor_rot: AAOS thoracolumbar rotation 0-45 each side, mostly thoracic = ASSUMPTION 35 (no in vivo series read)
thumb_cmc_abd: Q245: Cooney 1981 in vivo total CMC abduction-adduction 42 (AAOS thumb abduction 70 includes the first web and MCP, not the CMC alone); single source
thumb_cmc_flex: AAOS thumb flexion 15 / extension 20 (abstract only, not verified); Cooney 1981 in vivo total CMC flexion-extension 53 (split not in the abstract) - unchanged
thumb_ip: AAOS thumb IP flexion 0-80, extension 0-20 (abstract only, not verified; Hume 1990 functional 18)
thumb_mcp: AAOS thumb MCP flexion 0-50 (abstract only, not verified; Hume 1990 functional posture 21)
toe1_ip: AAOS great toe IP flexion 0-90 (abstract only, not verified; no series read)
toe1_mtp: AAOS great toe MTP flexion 0-45, extension 0-70 (abstract only, not verified; Nawoczenski 1999 active weight-bearing extension 44, Hopson 1995 about 65 needed for walking)
toe_dip: ASSUMPTION: lesser toes DIP flexion ~60 (few standard values)
toe_mtp: ASSUMPTION: lesser toes ~ +40 / -40 (no standard value found)
toe_pip: ASSUMPTION: lesser toes PIP flexion ~35 (few standard values)
wrist_dev: Q245: Kim 2014 goniometer n 52: radial 19.7 +- 3.0, ulnar 34.0 +- 3.7 (+ 1 SD 23 / 38); AAOS 20 / 30; single study
wrist_flex: Q245: Kim 2014 goniometer n 52: extension 71.1 +- 4.9, flexion 74.2 +- 5.1 (+ 1 SD 76 / 79); AAOS 70 / 80; single study
